description: Find an API, data source, or MCP server that can do something you cannot do on your own. Searches 35,000+ agent-callable tools: ~14,000 paid x402 endpoints and ~21,000 MCP servers, in one place. Use it whenever you need outside data or a capability you lack — web search, onchain and crypto data, company or people lookup, scraping, maps, weather, documents, financial data, travel, and more. Returns what each tool does, how to call or install it, and what it costs. Free to use.

kind.description: Optional. 'x402' for paid pay-per-call HTTP endpoints, 'mcp' for installable MCP servers. Omit to search both.

max_price_usd.description: Optional. Only return paid endpoints at or below this price per call.

need.description: What you need, in plain language. Describe the capability or data, not a tool name. Example: 'historical lithium spodumene prices' or 'check if a wallet holds an NFT'.

name: find_agent_tools
